The practical questions

Make room for the messy bit.

Is this a brand identity project?+

No. A material study is the working direction before a full identity, campaign or site. It gives the next project something solid to build from.

What do you need from us?+

A rough brief, a few references and the names of the people who will make the final call. Half formed is a useful starting point.

How long does it take?+

Most studies take two weeks from the first call to the handoff session. We keep the group small so decisions do not wait in a queue.

What is included in the handoff?+

A material board, type and image tests, a small set of rules, a recorded walkthrough and one working session with your team.

Can you work with an existing brand?+

Yes. We can extend an existing system, find its missing texture or help a new direction sit beside what already works.

What happens after the study?+

You can take the kit to your own team, bring us into production or ask for a separate proposal. There is no retainer attached.
